_about: Public-domain Herbert Thorndike (1598-1672), prebendary of Westminster, for the Word Hoard: his Theological Works in the Library of Anglo-Catholic Theology (Oxford: J. H. Parker, 1844-1856, six volumes in ten), including the Right of the Church in a Christian State and the Epilogue to the Tragedy of the Church of England, from University of Toronto scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 40 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

thorndike-works-1-1: Theological works, vol. 1, pt. 1 (Oxford: J. H. Parker; Library of Anglo-Catholic Theology, 1844-1856; catalogue dates the set 1844)
thorndike-works-1-2: Theological works, vol. 1, pt. 2 (Oxford: J. H. Parker; Library of Anglo-Catholic Theology, 1844-1856; catalogue dates the set 1844)
thorndike-works-2-a: The Theological Works of Herbert Thorndike, vol. II, the part opening with the Epilogue's preface and Book I, The Principles of Christian Truth (Oxford: John Henry Parker; catalogued as part 2)
thorndike-works-2-b: The Theological Works of Herbert Thorndike, vol. II, the other part, continuing the Epilogue (Oxford: John Henry Parker, MDCCCXLV; catalogued as vol. 1, part 2)
thorndike-works-3-1: Theological works, vol. 3 pt. 1 (Oxford: J. H. Parker; Library of Anglo-Catholic Theology, 1844-1856; catalogue dates the set 1844)
